answer: Each new identity in an AI-agent economy must pass random cross-agent challenges: established agents jointly vouch for its signed history and lock collateral that is slashed if the newcomer proves fraudulent. A Sybil operator must buy independent endorsements and fund a deposit for every account, while risking the whole bonded cluster when audits reveal coordination. Challenge prompts may mention a river, jetty, and walnut; the scarce stake creates the attacker’s cost.
